datasheet_identity.title: WPM3407 Single P-Channel, -30 V, -4.4 A Power MOSFET

extraction_notes: P-channel values are stored as magnitudes for fitting; original negative signs remain in conditions and figure labels. RDS(on) maximums are 0.046 ohm at VGS=-10 V, ID=-4.4 A and 0.066 ohm at VGS=-4.5 V, ID=-3.0 A.
IDSS maximum is 1 uA at VDS=-24 V, VGS=0 V, TJ=25 degC and 10 uA at TJ=85 degC. Gate-charge typicals are Qg=18 nC, Qgs=2.5 nC, Qgd=3.8 nC at VGS=-10 V, VDS=-15 V, ID=-5 A.

Body-diode reverse recovery is trr=25 ns and Qrr=14 nC at IF=-5 A, dI/dt=100 A/us. Thermal resistances are RthetaJA maximum 125 degC/W steady-state (90 degC/W typical) on the specified FR4 board and RthetaJC maximum 80 degC/W (50 degC/W typical).

The p. 3 typical-performance plots contain output and other traces, and p. 4 contains capacitance traces, but the required explicit temperature/test-mode and fixed-bias conditions are not all stated. No curve was retained rather than inferring conditions.
omission_reason: The datasheet contains typical output and capacitance plots, but the figure-level temperature and test-mode conditions required by the supplied context are not stated, and no transfer plot has a fixed VDS bias. No curves were inferred.
